levels.surface: الحاكم أبو علي الحسين بن أحمدالبيهقي

groups.saying_opens: إن الله عز وجل لا يسأل عباده
يا علي إن أول ما يسأل

notes: Saying 1 is the report's own chain. The narrator stands before the Imam, who speaks in his story, so the Imam al-Rida is the last link (owner ruling 5).
Sayings 2 and 3 are quotations inside the Imam's speech, each with its own chain (rule 4a). In saying 3 the Prophet ends the chain and is not a link.
«أبي» and «أبيه» with no name are relations. A name right after «أبيه» is one link, written as the name alone (rule 7).
Ibn Dhakwan's dream and the compiler's remark are not routes.
